objective: Derive deterministic relationship-level acquisition economics from canonical facts without creating another financial source of truth.
rules: The canonical relationship remains the analytics root.
Source facts are revalidated before projection.
Duplicate fact identities are rejected rather than silently double-counted.
Currencies are projected independently and are never summed across currencies.
Acquisition cost is the sum of acquisition-cost facts for a currency.
Quoted, written, and renewal premium remain separate measures.
Premium is never treated as River revenue.
Earned and paid commission remain separate observations.
Realized commission is paid commission plus recorded chargebacks plus recorded adjustments.
Contribution margin is realized commission minus acquisition cost.
Commission signs are respected exactly as recorded.
Latest renewal state is derived by renewal occurredAt and deterministic fact-id tie break.
The projection is derived and does not persist or rewrite canonical financial facts.
